personality.description: This person tends to organize daily routines carefully, keep close track of details, and prepare ahead before making decisions. They are open to new ideas when those ideas seem practical, but they still prefer familiar structures and stable routines over constant change. In moral dilemmas, they usually weigh rules and consequences with a strong focus on personal objectives, so they may choose the option that best protects their interests while justifying it through logic. In group discussions, they speak readily, confidently, and at length, often steering the conversation, challenging assumptions, and pressing their point of view in a direct, competitive way.
